dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature with a continuous posterior sweep from the basal insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute angular geometry with a minor rounded radius at the terminal morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree anterior slope relative to the longitudinal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The basal width is approximately 1.7 times the maximum vertical height from the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible caudal flukes showing a deep median notch and tapered tips characteristic of delphinid morphology.
